sources.snippet: My tug-of-war entry for the microduck arena. The plan is simple: lean back, pull hard, and let physics deliver the other duck into the pit. Tables for the five official bouts on top of rumezhak's tug-tab-v2, which already did most of the pulling. No ducks were hurt. One got very wet, metaphorically ...
